summary: The proof is complete. The recomputed complements are nonnegative and have mass at least a_y/4, the centroid identity places every retained endpoint centroid residual in W, and whole-label endpoint counting gives exactly 2H_Gamma. If S_Gamma is proper, its full mass gives Lambda_v at least H_Gamma/2; if it equals the synchronized endpoint set, the accepted lower bound of six endpoints makes minimum-weight deletion retain at least 5/6 of the endpoint mass and gives Lambda_v at least 5H_Gamma/12. The strict threshold then yields Lambda_v greater than Q/(400 gamma_d), so the accepted selector inequality gives R_sel(C)>Q/100. Finally, discarding at most Q/1000 leaves H_Gamma>33Q/2000, while gamma_d>4/11 makes 3Q/(500 gamma_d)<33Q/2000, with all strict inequalities preserved.
